lead.headline: The champ didn’t move. The 2-8 bowl flipped anyway.
lead.dek: No adds, no swaps, no kicker. Overnight Emmett Johnson’s projection jumped to 19.6, and Big Stric Energy went from favorite to a 45.4% underdog with its playoff life on the line.
lead.pull: Big Stric Energy did the work. The projections did the rest, and they did it for the other guy.
body: Yesterday this column flipped its pick to Big Stric Energy. It had made the biggest call in the league, Geno Smith in at quarterback, and it had 14.8 points banked from Nico Collins before the champ scored a thing. This morning I’m flipping back, and not because anybody did anything. Nobody did. There were no moves overnight. The ground just moved.

Here’s what moved it. Maye I touch your TDs?’s Emmett Johnson now projects for 19.6, up overnight and now the best number on the champ’s roster, ahead of Amon-Ra St. Brown (19.14) and Bucky Irving (18.28). On the other side, Big Stric’s Rashee Rice slid to 15.63. Add it up and the champ projects 155.85 to Big Stric’s 151.26. A 4.59-point game, and the champ is a 54.6% favorite.

Remember where this started: the weekly edition had Big Stric opening Week 11 as a 77.4% favorite. That number is gone. What’s left is a coin flip with a lean, and Big Stric still has two calls to make. Dalton Kincaid is Doubtful with the thumb, Tucker Kraft is on bye, and there is no tight end on the bench. And Saquon Barkley (12.69) is sitting behind Braelon Allen (9.01). Make that swap and Big Stric’s best lineup is 152.62. It still trails.

The champ has one open question of its own: Matt Gay is still Questionable with a hip, and he is being dropped league-wide by the tens of thousands. There’s no kicker on the bench. Cairo Santos (6.56) and Chase McLaughlin (6.63) are both free, and McLaughlin now projects higher than Gay (6.48) does healthy.

Why this is the game of the day: the winner stays alive for the last playoff spot. Santa Clara’s Finest hold it at 57.1%. The champ is at 25.2%. Big Stric is at 17.7%. Two 2-8 teams, and the loser is in real trouble by Monday night. My pick: the champ, narrowly. Big Stric’s path is Josh Allen and Justin Jefferson going off, and a tight end showing up from somewhere.

quick_hits.headline: First deadline: Poochinski, 10:00 AM
quick_hits.body: Jadarian Price is on bye in Poochinski’s FLEX, and the answer, Luther Burden III (15.31), plays in the first window. So does Caleb Williams (20.34), sitting behind Aaron Rodgers (16.64). Make both calls and Poochinski’s best is 172.73, a 63.4% favorite over Santa Clara’s Finest. The Seattle Seahawks D/ST is still listed, still on bye, and the Detroit Lions D/ST (6.56) is still free.

quick_hits.headline: AB81: four byes, three answers
quick_hits.body: AB81 starts Matthew Stafford, Kyren Williams, Jaxon Smith-Njigba and Rhamondre Stevenson, all on bye. The bench has Mike Evans (14.0, Questionable), DeVonta Smith (13.6) and George Kittle (12.52), and Kittle is also the better tight end over Mark Andrews (7.4). As set it’s 69.35; filled, 109.47 and an 11% shot against deeboliciouskins. The quarterback and one FLEX have to come off the wire.

quick_hits.headline: Coleman in, and Bowers decides the rest
quick_hits.body: Cherry Blossom’s best lineup (165.31) has Jonah Coleman (17.27) in the FLEX over Jameson Williams (12.25), and Bo Nix (17.92) over Jared Goff (17.0). Brock Bowers is Questionable with the ankle; if he sits, Tre Tucker (8.44) is next up. Bowers’ deadline is Sun 1:25 PM. Get it right and Cherry Blossom is 64.1% against an 8-2 team that leads 21.46 to 0.0.

quick_hits.headline: Two kickers needed, two kickers free
quick_hits.body: deeboliciouskins still lists Jason Myers, on bye, and is an 89% favorite anyway. The champ still lists Matt Gay, Questionable. Chase McLaughlin (6.63) and Cairo Santos (6.56) are both on the wire. One each, and nobody has to fight over it.

quick_hits.headline: Two teams are finished. Both trail as projected.
quick_hits.body: Santa Clara’s Finest (159.78) and Bad things man bad things (150.15) have no open calls left, and both lead on Thursday points. Both are also underdogs: 36.6% and 35.9%. Being set is the floor. The rest is up to the opponents’ front offices.

w11-m1.headline: The 2-8 bowl flips back to the champ
w11-m1.blurb: Maye I touch your TDs? projects 155.85 to 151.26 and is 54.6% to win, without making a move. Big Stric Energy leads 14.8 to 0.0 and needs a tight end. Winner stays in the race for the last spot.

w11-m2.headline: deeboliciouskins needs a kicker, AB81 needs everything
w11-m2.blurb: deeboliciouskins is 89% to win with only Jason Myers’ bye to fix. AB81 has four starters on bye and a 109.47 ceiling.

w11-m3.headline: Bad things leads, Cherry Blossom favored
w11-m3.blurb: Bad things man bad things banked 21.46 from C.J. Stroud and is done. Cherry Blossom is 64.1% because of Jonah Coleman, Bo Nix and whatever Brock Bowers’ ankle says by 1:25 PM.

w11-m4.headline: Poochinski’s call comes first, at 10:00 AM
w11-m4.blurb: Santa Clara’s Finest lead 16.0 to 0.0, are set at 159.78, and are 36.6% to win. Poochinski is 63.4% if Burden goes in by 10:00 AM. Still the upset I’d pick if I had to pick one; I don’t, so it’s Poochinski.

w11-r2-s8.headline: Burden for Price, due at 10:00 AM
w11-r2-s8.blurb: Jadarian Price is on bye. Luther Burden III (15.31) is the answer, and his game kicks off in the first window: Sun 10:00 AM. The earliest call on the board.

w11-r2-s10.headline: Poochinski still needs a defense
w11-r2-s10.blurb: The Seattle Seahawks D/ST is on bye with no backup. The Detroit Lions D/ST (6.56) is free.

w11-r1-s6.headline: What will Big Stric do at tight end?
w11-r1-s6.blurb: Dalton Kincaid (9.5) is Doubtful with the thumb, Tucker Kraft is on bye, and the bench has no tight end. In a game Big Stric now trails as projected, this is the call.

w11-r3-s9.headline: The champ’s kicker, day three
w11-r3-s9.blurb: Matt Gay (6.48) is still Questionable with a hip. Chase McLaughlin (6.63) projects higher and is free. In a 4.59-point game, take the healthy one.

w11-r6-s9.headline: deeboliciouskins needs a kicker
w11-r6-s9.blurb: Jason Myers is on bye. Chase McLaughlin (6.63) or Cairo Santos (6.56). The last hole in a 172.07 lineup.

w11-r8-s1.headline: Where does AB81 find a quarterback?
w11-r8-s1.blurb: Matthew Stafford is on bye, Sam Darnold is Out, Jalen Hurts is on IR. Justin Herbert (16.58) is the only one playing. The second QB comes from the wire.

w11-r8-s3.headline: AB81’s shuffle at running back
w11-r8-s3.blurb: Kyren Williams is on bye. The fix is a flex shuffle: Mike Evans (14.0, Questionable), DeVonta Smith (13.6) or George Kittle (12.52). Deadline Sun 1:25 PM.

w11-r8-s6.headline: Kittle over Andrews
w11-r8-s6.blurb: George Kittle (12.52) sits behind Mark Andrews (7.4). Still the easiest points on the board. Deadline Sun 5:20 PM.

w11-r4-s7.headline: Bowers or Coleman?
w11-r4-s7.blurb: Brock Bowers (14.68) is Questionable with an ankle. Jonah Coleman (17.27) projects higher anyway. My call: Coleman in for Jameson Williams, and Bowers plays if the ankle does. Deadline Sun 1:25 PM.
